cues: A lightweight tubular frame joins the steering bar, crank assembly, and rear fork into a rigid structure.
Two slim rims carry tensioned spokes, distributing the rider’s weight while keeping each wheel relatively light.
A toothed chain loops between front and rear sprockets, transferring leg power to the back wheel.
Rubber tires wrap narrow rims, with patterned tread gripping pavement and absorbing small jolts.
A padded saddle rests above the seat post, adjustable to suit different riders and riding positions.
Hand-operated levers pull brake cables, pressing pads against the rims to slow the rolling machine.
The crank arms turn with each downward pedal stroke, converting muscular effort into forward motion.
Sealed bearings keep grit and moisture away from moving joints within the compact metal frame.
